sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - MP-133 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. I don't have much time today, plus the programmer unit for PLC100 is out of order, so let's get straight to business. I build various weapons with modifications for my clients, and I'll need some help with it. I need you to mod an MP-133 shotgun. I won't have time to build it myself, and I don't have parts for it either anyway. This gun should have more than 45 ergonomics, a laser designator, an extended mag, and less than 850 recoil sum. And make it compact, too, not more than 4 slots. Build one for me, and I'll pay you well."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 2 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an MP-133 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +800 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 10,000 Roubles
  - 10,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 11,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Screw nuts
- 1× Bolts
- 1× 12/70 makeshift .50 BMG slug ammo pack (25 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Windham Weaponry Rail Gas Block at Mechanic LL1
"You've got it? Leave it in the corner, thank you. A beautiful thing, right? Anyway, I'm a little busy right now, can't talk for long."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
MP-133 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 45 or greater ergonomics
- 850 or less recoil
- 4 or fewer cells of space
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 5
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard MP-133 from Jaeger LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
